summary: Enhance your skills with our Cost Reduction and Value Analysis Training Course. Learn effective strategies to optimize costs and maximize value in your projects
lede: Cost analysis training uses value analysis to identify avoidable costs while preserving required functions, quality, and service. It is designed for professionals influencing sourcing, engineering, operations, or lifecycle cost decisions who need to assess cost-reduction opportunities without relying on price cuts alone. Learners practice clarifying functions with FAST, comparing should-cost models and total cost of ownership, and prioritizing and validating savings through weighted criteria and baseline and variance analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence product, service, process, sourcing, or lifecycle cost decisions and need a repeatable value analysis method. It suits intermediate and advanced learners who can interpret operational or financial information and want stronger tools for cross-functional cost reduction.
modules: Value Management and Cost Reduction Foundations
FAST Function Analysis and Value Drivers
Cost Data, Pareto, and Opportunity Diagnosis
Value Improvement and Lean Six Sigma
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to procurement, cost analysis, engineering, operations, finance, or supplier management. Familiarity with spreadsheets, spend data, budgets, or operational KPIs will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted cost classification and Power BI reporting are taught at operational application level, while full enterprise deployment and specialist engineering implementation remain outside the five-day scope.
